analysisNotes: [
        { zone:'The 78.99–79.00 zone is crucial: Pivot S1 (79.00) and the breakout level for the bearish scenario, close to the previous day low (78.44). Holding above or breaking below defines short-term direction.', news:'High-impact US data (Michigan Consumer Sentiment Prel, Building Permits) can move the DXY and, in turn, oil. Middle East tensions add a geopolitical risk premium.' },
        { zone:'The most critical zone for ES today is 7539–7500. Zero Gamma at 7539 is the key level: above it market makers suppress volatility and buy dips; below, they amplify moves. Put Wall at 7500 is strong institutional support.', news:'US construction and consumer confidence data, plus Middle East tensions, are the catalysts. The rising VIX (+2.5%) points to institutional risk-off.' },
        { zone:'The 3973.00–3976.00 zone is critical: the 10-day swing low and yesterday\u2019s low, close to the lower Bollinger Band (3964). A break below confirms downward pressure.', news:'High-impact US data (Michigan Sentiment, Building Permits, Housing Starts) drives Gold. Weak data lifts Gold as a safe haven; strong data strengthens the dollar and pressures it.' },
        { zone:'The critical zone for NQ is 28999–29027 — confluence of Zero Gamma (29027), EMA9 (28999), Put Wall and Max Pain (29000). Losing this zone, especially Zero Gamma, signals amplified downside.', news:'Michigan Consumer Sentiment and US construction data influence rate-cut expectations. Middle East risk adds a risk-off bias, pressuring growth assets like NQ.' },
      ]
